title: Claim — an interpretation or judgement, always attributed and falsifiable
description: Unifies today's findings, architecture assertions, flow statements and risks into one ledger. Rendering is derived from this record; no artifact may state a claim absent here.

statement.description: One decidable sentence. Not a paragraph, not a recommendation.

method.description: CONFIRMED requires at least one of runtime_probe or test_evidence, or a deterministic graph probe.

fact_ids.description: Deterministic facts this claim rests on.

evidence_ids.description: Evidence records backing this claim. A claim must cite at least one evidence id or one fact id; which of the two is enforced by the ledger, not by this schema.

falsifier.description: What observation would disprove this claim. Mandatory — a claim nobody can refute is not an engineering claim.

refuted_by.description: Kept in the ledger; refuted claims are never deleted.

scenario.description: Concrete change or failure scenario. A coupling number without a scenario is noise.

disposition.description: Rule R5: every risk-type claim ends in a task or a documented acceptance with owner and expiry.

artifacts.description: Artifact IDs (A1..A15) this claim is rendered into. Rule R4: a claim is presented in full exactly once.

legacy_id.description: Identifier of the pre-ledger record this claim was bridged from.

status.description: Lifecycle of the claim itself, not of any fix.

probe_spec.description: How this claim can be mechanically re-decided: {probe_type, specification}. A claim that declares this can be confirmed or refuted on any later snapshot.

origin.description: Whether the claim is about product code, test and fixture code, or both. A reader must never confuse a finding in a fixture with a finding in the product.

priority.description: Composite priority: reach × confidence × origin ÷ cost. Never a severity label.

priority_factors.description: Every input the priority was computed from, so the ordering can be argued with.

render.description: A template key and its parameters, so the same claim can be rendered in the reader language without translating machine text.
